# amiga-ahi reference index

AHI (Audio Hardware Interface) retargetable audio: the ahi.device library calls, the
device I/O interface, tags and structures, from the AHI 6 developer kit.

- [Sources](SOURCE.md) · [Errata](errata.md) · [LVO table (TSV)](data/ahi.tsv) · [Driver LVO table (TSV)](data/ahi_sub.tsv)

## Guides

- [AHI audio modes](topics/audio-modes.md) — How to choose the mode ID and mixing rate an AHI program allocates: take the user's default, ask with the requester, search with AHI_BestAudioIDA, or enumerate the database.

- [AHI overview](topics/overview.md) — AHI is the retargetable audio system for AmigaOS (author Martin Blom, LGPL device, GPL tools).

## Library functions

| Function | LVO | Registers | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [AHI_AddAudioMode](functions.md#ahi_addaudiomode) | -150 | AHIPrivate=A0 | Add one mode (described by a database taglist) to the audio mode database (V4). |
| [AHI_AllocAudioA](functions.md#ahi_allocaudioa) (alias: AHI_AllocAudio) | -42 | tagList=A1 | Allocate the audio hardware in one mode and return the control handle. |
| [AHI_AllocAudioRequestA](functions.md#ahi_allocaudiorequesta) (alias: AHI_AllocAudioRequest) | -120 | tagList=A0 | Allocate an audio mode requester structure. |
| [AHI_AudioRequestA](functions.md#ahi_audiorequesta) (alias: AHI_AudioRequest) | -126 | Requester=A0, tagList=A1 | Show the mode requester and let the user pick a mode and frequency. |
| [AHI_BestAudioIDA](functions.md#ahi_bestaudioida) (alias: AHI_BestAudioID) | -114 | tagList=A1 | Pick the mode ID that best satisfies a set of required and preferred attributes. |
| [AHI_ControlAudioA](functions.md#ahi_controlaudioa) (alias: AHI_ControlAudio) | -60 | AudioCtrl=A2, tagList=A1 | Start/stop playback or recording, swap hooks, and set or query sound-card controls. |
| [AHI_FreeAudio](functions.md#ahi_freeaudio) | -48 | AudioCtrl=A2 | Release the hardware, all loaded sounds and the control handle. |
| [AHI_FreeAudioRequest](functions.md#ahi_freeaudiorequest) | -132 | Requester=A0 | Free a requester from AHI_AllocAudioRequestA. |
| [AHI_GetAudioAttrsA](functions.md#ahi_getaudioattrsa) (alias: AHI_GetAudioAttrs) | -108 | ID=D0, Audioctrl=A2, tagList=A1 | Read attributes of a mode, or of the mode an allocated handle is using. |
| [AHI_LoadModeFile](functions.md#ahi_loadmodefile) | -162 | AHIPrivate=A0 | Add all modes from an IFF-AHIM mode file, or from every file in a directory (V4). |
| [AHI_LoadSound](functions.md#ahi_loadsound) | -90 | Sound=D0, Type=D1, Info=A0, AudioCtrl=A2 | Register sample data under a sound ID so channels can play it. |
| [AHI_NextAudioID](functions.md#ahi_nextaudioid) | -102 | Last_ID=D0 | Iterate over all mode IDs in the audio mode database. |
| [AHI_PlayA](functions.md#ahi_playa) (alias: AHI_Play) | -138 | Audioctrl=A2, tagList=A1 | Set sound, rate, volume and one loop for several channels in one call (V4). |
| [AHI_RemoveAudioMode](functions.md#ahi_removeaudiomode) | -156 | AHIPrivate=D0 | Remove a mode from the audio mode database (V4). |
| [AHI_SampleFrameSize](functions.md#ahi_sampleframesize) | -144 | SampleType=D0 | Return the size in bytes of one frame of a sample format. |
| [AHI_SetEffect](functions.md#ahi_seteffect) | -84 | Effect=A0, AudioCtrl=A2 | Switch a mixer effect on or off by passing its effect structure. |
| [AHI_SetFreq](functions.md#ahi_setfreq) | -72 | Channel=D0, Freq=D1, AudioCtrl=A2, Flags=D2 | Set a channel's playback rate in Hz. |
| [AHI_SetSound](functions.md#ahi_setsound) | -78 | Channel=D0, Sound=D1, Offset=D2, Length=D3, AudioCtrl=A2, Flags=D4 | Select the sound (or a part of it) a channel plays; `AHI_NOSOUND` turns the channel off. |
| [AHI_SetVol](functions.md#ahi_setvol) | -66 | Channel=D0, Volume=D1, Pan=D2, AudioCtrl=A2, Flags=D3 | Set a channel's volume and stereo position. |
| [AHI_UnloadSound](functions.md#ahi_unloadsound) | -96 | Sound=D0, Audioctrl=A2 | Tell AHI a sound ID is no longer used. |

## Device interface and tag sections

- `AHIA tags` — Tags for AHI_AllocAudioA; hooks, PlayerFreq and UserData also work in AHI_ControlAudioA. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahia-tags)
- `AHIAudioCtrl` — Handle returned by AHI_AllocAudioA; only its first field is public. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahiaudioctrl)
- `AHIAudioModeRequester` — Read-only result structure of AHI_AllocAudioRequestA / AHI_AudioRequestA. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahiaudiomoderequester)
- `AHIB_Dizzy` — After the hard filters in the main list are applied, the mode that best matches the AHIDB_ tags in this second list (most wanted features, fewest unwanted) wins. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahib_dizzy)
- `AHIC tags` — Control tags for AHI_ControlAudioA: start/stop and sound-card hardware settings. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahic-tags)
- `AHIDB tags` — Mode database attributes read by AHI_GetAudioAttrsA and matched by AHI_BestAudioIDA. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahidb-tags)
- `AHIE error codes` — Results of AHI_ControlAudioA, AHI_LoadSound, AHI_SetEffect and device `io_Error`. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahie-error-codes)
- `AHIEffChannelInfo` — Effect structure whose hook gets each channel's play position (`AHIET_CHANNELINFO`, V4). → [tags.md](tags.md#ahieffchannelinfo)
- `AHIEffDSPEcho` — Effect structure for the echo/delay DSP (`AHIET_DSPECHO`, V4). → [tags.md](tags.md#ahieffdspecho)
- `AHIEffDSPMask` — Effect structure choosing which channels the DSP effects process (`AHIET_DSPMASK`, V4). → [tags.md](tags.md#ahieffdspmask)
- `AHIEffMasterVolume` — Effect structure scaling the whole mix (`AHIET_MASTERVOLUME`). → [tags.md](tags.md#ahieffmastervolume)
- `AHIEffOutputBuffer` — Effect structure giving a hook read-only access to mixed output (`AHIET_OUTPUTBUFFER`). → [tags.md](tags.md#ahieffoutputbuffer)
- `AHIET effect types` — Values for `ahie_Effect`, the first ULONG of every AHI_SetEffect structure. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahiet-effect-types)
- `AHIP tags` — Program tags for AHI_PlayA (V4); order matters, each channel is bracketed. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahip-tags)
- `AHIR tags` — Tags for AHI_AllocAudioRequestA and AHI_AudioRequestA (like the ASL screenmode requester). → [tags.md](tags.md#ahir-tags)
- `AHIRecordMessage` — Message (A1) passed to the RecordFunc hook. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahirecordmessage)
- `AHIRequest` — Extended `IOStdReq` used for every ahi.device command. → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#ahirequest)
- `AHISampleInfo` — Sample descriptor passed as `info` to AHI_LoadSound for sample-type sounds. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahisampleinfo)
- `AHISF flags` — Flags for the `Flags` argument of AHI_SetVol, AHI_SetFreq and AHI_SetSound. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahisf-flags)
- `AHISoundMessage` — Message (A1) passed to the SoundFunc hook. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahisoundmessage)
- `AHIST sample formats` — Sample formats for `ahisi_Type`, `ahir_Type`, `ahirm_Type` and `ahieob_Type`. → [tags.md](tags.md#ahist-sample-formats)
- `AHIST sound types` → [tags.md](tags.md#ahist-sound-types)
- `AHIUnitPrefs, AHIGlobalPrefs` — Layouts of the `AHIU`/`AHIG` chunks of `ENV:Sys/ahi.prefs` (rarely read by programs). → [tags.md](tags.md#ahiunitprefs-ahiglobalprefs)
- `CloseDevice` — Close the unit opened with this request; every successful OpenDevice needs one. → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#closedevice)
- `CMD_FLUSH, CMD_RESET` — Abort every program's requests; RESET also reloads prefs and resets the hardware (V4). → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#cmd_flush-cmd_reset)
- `CMD_READ` — Record `io_Length` bytes from the preferred input in your format and rate (V4). → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#cmd_read)
- `CMD_STOP, CMD_START` — Pause all CMD_WRITE processing, then release the queued writes together (V4). → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#cmd_stop-cmd_start)
- `CMD_WRITE` — Play `io_Length` bytes of samples on the unit, mixed with other programs (V4). → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#cmd_write)
- `Double buffering` — Gap-free streaming: queue the next buffer while one plays, chained by `ahir_Link`. → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#double-buffering)
- `Example: play a buffer` — Complete C function: open unit 0 and play one second of 8-bit tone with DoIO. → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#example-play-a-buffer)
- `Example: streaming with ahir_Link` — Complete C function: gap-free 16-bit stereo stream from a fill callback until Ctrl-C. → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#example-streaming-with-ahir_link)
- `Fixed, sposition` — AHI's 16.16 fixed-point types used for volume, pan, gains and PlayerFreq. → [tags.md](tags.md#fixed-sposition)
- `NSCMD_DEVICEQUERY` — Standard New-Style-Device query of device type and supported commands (V4). → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#nscmd_devicequery)
- `OpenDevice` — Open ahi.device on a unit for I/O, or on `AHI_NO_UNIT` to reach the library API. → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#opendevice)
- `Several sounds at once` — Play overlapping sounds by sending one copied request per sound. → [device-interface.md](device-interface.md#several-sounds-at-once)
- `Special IDs and values` — Reserved mode IDs, frequencies and sound numbers. → [tags.md](tags.md#special-ids-and-values)
